snippet.title: You are a cat surrounded by monsters inside a castle tower.
snippet.description:
You are just a cat, with a weapon in hand inside a castle tower surrounded by monsters of all kinds.

Bloodspire brings the thrill of classic Roguelike games! Challenge your friends or family in this intense game.

A fast-paced action Roguelike with card upgrades and unique abilities.

The rules are simple: Survive or Give Up!
